title: panelaudit: panel-first pharmacogenomic audit
description:
Panel-first rather than sample-first. Enumerates every diplotype expressible from CPIC allele definitions for a gene, projects each onto a candidate genotyping panel, and classifies the result as CORRECT, NO_CALL or WRONG against the phenotype CPIC assigns. Diplotype probabilities follow from Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium over CPIC's published per-population allele frequencies, and candidate loci are ranked by the carrier burden each one recovers.

It needs no cohort and no sequencing run: an uninterrogated position is operationally indistinguishable from the reference sequence, so a panel's behaviour on every genotype can be computed before any patient is sequenced.

Seven genes are audited (DPYD, TPMT, NUDT15, CYP2B6, CYP2C19, CYP2C9, CYP3A5) and seven are refused by name with reasons, because refusing beats producing a confidently wrong report.

Python 3.10+, standard library only. No patient data, no reference genome, no VCF. CPIC content bundled under CC0 1.0; code under Apache-2.0.
